prompt: Create an amulet that lets the wearer cast several powerful control spells from the item without concentration.
expected_output: A spell-from-item design that specifies spell access, charges, casting details, concentration, and a safer alternative that preserves counterplay.

assertions.text: Does not silently remove concentration or create hidden spell slots
Records casting time, range, targets, duration, save/DC, charges, and recovery
Audits action economy, control duration, and repeatability against comparators
Offers a safer alternative that preserves counterplay if the brief demands no-concentration control
